literal: Those who planned will lose their plans, if those who approach, having known the place and having closely approached, act.
translation: Even those who have carefully planned an attack will lose their designs, if their opponents understand the terrain, closely secure their position, and act.
modern: பகைவர்கள் தகுந்த இடத்தை அறிந்து, நெருங்கிச் செயல்பட்டால், அவர்களை வெல்ல எண்ணியவர்கள் தங்கள் எண்ணத்தை இழந்து தோற்பார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme importance of choosing the right location in strategic endeavors. Even if an adversary has made elaborate plans to conquer, those plans will fail if the opposing side understands the terrain (இடனறிந்து), positions themselves closely and securely (துன்னி), and executes their actions (செயின்). The word 'துன்னியார்' refers to those who draw near to engage, and 'துன்னி' emphasizes the act of closely securing the strategic spot. Thus, strategic placement and timely action can completely dismantle the pre-planned schemes of any powerful opponent.
